subject.why: The cupcake is complete and instantly recognizable, featuring swirled pink frosting, a red-and-white striped case, and a glossy red heart candy topper as specified.

category.why: The object rests on a flat, solid-colour surface against a smooth gradient wall from the same warm orange color family, cleanly split at a clear horizon line.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, watermarks, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The cupcake is centered with generous, balanced margins on all sides.

colour.why: Vibrant, warm, and saturated palette where the pink and red cupcake separates cleanly from the warm orange background.

detail.why: There is no micro-detail, noisy texture, or unnecessary clutter; shapes remain clean and bold.

style.why: Features chunky 3D volumes, smooth satin sheen, soft shadows, and clean edges without outlines, matching the reference art style.
